style: Editorial commercial photography for a B2B automotive-technology advisory. Photorealistic, shot on a full-frame camera, natural lens, real materials. Colour grade: cool deep-navy shadows (#072B46 family), clean neutral highlights, restrained. Where a light source is visible, a small vivid lime-green (#56D110) signal light is welcome but never dominant. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks, no recognisable faces, no illustration, no CGI look.

images.name: market-trucks
images.alt: A Class 8 truck on an interstate at dusk
images.prompt: A modern long-haul Class 8 semi-truck driving on a North American interstate at blue-hour dusk, three-quarter front view from a low roadside angle, headlights on, motion blur in the road surface, a compact radar sensor visible in the front bumper, wide empty landscape, deep blue sky.

images.name: market-lastmile
images.alt: Trailers and delivery vans at a distribution yard at dawn
images.prompt: A logistics distribution yard at dawn: rows of white box trailers backed into loading docks and a line of electric last-mile delivery vans, wet asphalt reflecting sodium and cool LED lights, high vantage point, orderly composition, no people visible.

images.name: market-offroad
images.alt: Autonomous tractor working a field at first light
images.prompt: A large modern agricultural tractor with roof-mounted perception sensors working a vast field at first light, dust and low sun haze, an excavator faintly visible on a construction site in the far distance, cinematic wide-angle, earth tones under a cool blue sky.

images.name: market-robotics
images.alt: Autonomous mobile robots moving through a warehouse aisle
images.prompt: Autonomous mobile robots (low flat AMRs) carrying shelving units through a tall, clean, dimly lit warehouse aisle, a robotic forklift in the background, cool blue LED lighting, small green status lights on the robots, symmetrical one-point perspective, no people.

images.name: market-infra
images.alt: A smart-city intersection at night seen from above
images.prompt: Top-down aerial view of a busy city intersection at night with long-exposure light trails from cars, crosswalk markings, traffic sensors on gantries, deep navy and amber tones, a few green traffic lights, geometric and calm.

images.name: problem-lab
images.alt: An automotive radar module on an engineering test bench
images.prompt: An automotive radar sensor module and an automotive camera module on an engineering test bench in a vehicle validation lab, an anechoic radar test chamber with blue-grey foam pyramids blurred in the background, a vehicle front bumper on a stand, shallow depth of field, precise and technical.

images.name: perception-macro
images.alt: Close-up of a roof-mounted lidar unit
images.prompt: Macro close-up of a roof-mounted automotive lidar sensor and a camera pod on a vehicle roof rack, glossy dark glass, machined aluminium, a thin green status LED, dark navy background, product-photography lighting with a soft rim light.

images.name: cta-highway
images.alt: Aerial view of a highway interchange at night
images.prompt: Aerial drone photograph of a large highway interchange at night, long-exposure light trails tracing the curves, surrounding land almost black, very deep navy colour grade, plenty of dark negative space on the left third.
